questions.q: This sign indicates the center of the road or the center line.
This sign indicates that the traffic restriction shown applies to the road ahead.
Driving with an expired license is considered driving without a license.
Overtaking a vehicle that is overtaking another regular car is considered double overtaking and is a violation.
When lanes are separated by a yellow line, you must not cross the yellow line to change lanes.
This sign indicates a steep uphill slope ahead.
During a driver’s license renewal, tests for vision, hearing, and other aptitudes are conducted.
On a dry road where the friction coefficient is higher, the stopping distance of a vehicle decreases.
On a road with a white broken center line, you must not overtake by crossing into the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: A white solid line prohibits crossing for overtaking.

questions.q: Overtaking is prohibited in tunnels unless there are marked lanes.
This sign prohibits passage of all light vehicles.
questions.explanation: The sign prohibits passage of light vehicles except bicycles (e.g., rickshaws).

questions.q: If there is a change in the name or address listed on a driver’s license, it must be reported to the Public Safety Commission of the place of residence.
The driver’s license point system exists, and if there have been no suspensions in the past three years, a license suspension occurs with 6 to 14 points.
In the event of a traffic accident, reporting to the police takes precedence over preventing further accidents or aiding the injured.
questions.explanation: Preventing further accidents and aiding the injured come first.

questions.q: Even if more than one year has passed since obtaining a regular motorcycle license, a newly obtained large motorcycle license requires one year before carrying a passenger.
questions.explanation: You can carry a passenger immediately with a large motorcycle license.

questions.q: The stopping position at a location with this sign is 3 meters before the sign.
questions.explanation: The stopping position is immediately before the sign.

questions.q: The validity period of an international driver’s license is three years from the issuance date.
questions.explanation: The validity period is one year from the issuance date.

questions.q: Police cars, fire trucks, and ambulances are emergency vehicles, but emergency work vehicles are not included.
questions.explanation: Emergency work vehicles are also considered emergency vehicles.

questions.q: If you have a motorized bicycle license, you can drive a small special vehicle.
questions.explanation: A motorized bicycle license only allows driving motorized bicycles.

questions.q: When driving a bus or taxi for repositioning without passengers, a second-class license is not required.
This sign prohibits pedestrian passage, and a motorized bicycle cannot pass even if the engine is off and it is being pushed.
When visibility is poor due to fog, it is better to drive with low beam headlights as high beams worsen visibility.
Parking is prohibited within 3 meters of a fire alarm.
questions.explanation: Parking is prohibited within 1 meter of a fire alarm.

questions.q: At an intersection with three or more lanes in the direction of travel and traffic signals, a motorized bicycle must perform a two-stage right turn unless a two-stage right turn prohibition sign is present.
Signals for left turns, right turns, or U-turns should be given 30 meters before the location.
This sign prohibits passage of large trucks, large special vehicles, and specific medium trucks.
questions.explanation: This is a sign prohibiting passage of large passenger vehicles.

questions.q: The braking distance is the distance from feeling danger and pressing the brake pedal until the brakes start to take effect.
questions.explanation: This is the free-running distance.

questions.q: The maximum load capacity for a motorized bicycle is 60 kg.
questions.explanation: The maximum load capacity is 30 kg.

questions.q: When passing a tram boarding area equipped with barriers for passengers, you only need to drive slowly through.
You must drive slowly on a steep uphill slope.
questions.explanation: Slow driving is required on a steep downhill slope.

questions.q: This sign prohibits vehicles from proceeding in directions other than the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates lane assignments for specific directions at an intersection.

questions.q: Loading or unloading cargo is considered stopping if within 5 minutes, and parking if exceeding 5 minutes.
Even in a no-U-turn zone, U-turns are allowed within an intersection.
questions.explanation: U-turns are prohibited in such zones, including within intersections.

questions.q: The signal for changing lanes should be given 3 seconds before the change.
Parking or stopping is prohibited within 5 meters of the edge of a roadwork zone.
questions.explanation: Only parking is prohibited within this distance.

questions.q: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This is a sign for a pedestrian-only road.

questions.q: When overtaking another vehicle, you must confirm that the location is not a no-overtaking zone.
Parking or stopping is generally prohibited on highways.
When driving past a school bus stopped to pick up or drop off children, you must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Drivers only need to slow down and proceed with caution when passing a stopped school bus with its hazard lights on; a full stop is not required.

questions.q: You do not need to drive slowly near a road curve if visibility is good.
questions.explanation: Slow driving is required near curves regardless of visibility.

questions.q: This sign indicates a dedicated lane where only designated vehicles, small special vehicles, motorized bicycles, and light vehicles can pass.
questions.explanation: This is a priority bus lane sign.

questions.q: When applying emergency brakes in a vehicle with ABS, it is best to press the pedal fully and hold it to activate the ABS.
Parking or stopping is prohibited on highways, but temporary stopping is allowed if unavoidable.
Overtaking is when a vehicle changes its path to move ahead of a vehicle in front.
questions.explanation: Overtaking does not involve changing paths; that is passing.

questions.q: A motorcycle suitable for the rider’s physique is one where both toes touch the ground when straddling it.
This sign prohibits passage of all vehicles, including motorized bicycles and light vehicles.
questions.explanation: The sign prohibits passage of all traffic, including pedestrians.

questions.q: Braking distance is generally proportional to the square of the speed.
Police hand signals take precedence over traffic light signals.
During a major earthquake, it is better to evacuate by car than on foot.
questions.explanation: Evacuation by car is prohibited during major earthquakes.

questions.q: Driving continuously for long periods on highways is dangerous, so it is advisable to take a break every two hours.
